bio: Housed in the swish Saint Ten boutique hotel not far from San Sava church in the Vračar district, the dining room, appointed in a contemporary vein, lies just past the welcoming open-plan hotel lobby-cum-lounge. European-influenced cuisine takes front stage here, with a weakness for meat (try the Hoisin duck or the Saint Ten beef fillet - the latter is the house signature), although the menu also features a few fish dishes, including tuna fillet and grilled or steamed salmon. Vegetarians will enjoy the kale rolls. The plush, cosy Lounge Bar is perfect for a relaxing aperitif or after-dinner drink....
